fact: 1913年1月23日，统一与进步委员会（CUP）成员在恩维尔与塔拉特率领下突袭高门（Bâb-ı Âlî），时内阁正在开会；陆军大臣纳齐姆帕夏在冲突中被杀，大维齐尔卡米尔帕夏被迫辞职。政变以「卡米尔要把埃迪尔内交给保加利亚」为口实，新政府由谢夫凯特帕夏出任大维齐尔，当日撤回伦敦和会代表、退出停战，2月3日恢复对保加利亚作战。

sources.title: Second Constitutional Era（Wikiwand，述突袭高门与后果）
sources.quote: On 23 January 1913, Enver Bey burst with some of his associates into the Sublime Porte while the cabinet was in session, a raid in which the Minister of War Nazım Pasha was killed. A new CUP government was formed, headed by Grand Vizier Mahmud Shevket Pasha.

sources.title: Committee of Union and Progress（Wikipedia 镜像页）
sources.quote: the CUP launched a preemptive strike: a coup d'état known as the Raid on the Sublime Porte on 23 January 1913. During the coup Kâmil Pasha was forced to resign as Grand Vizier at gunpoint and War Minister Nâzım Pasha was accidentally murdered. ... The pro-war regime immediately withdrew the Empire's delegation from the London conference on the same day it took power. ... On 3 February 1913 the war resumed.

fact: 1913年5月30日，奥斯曼帝国签署《伦敦条约》，承认失去鲁米利亚全境、仅保留君士坦丁堡及其周边；第一次巴尔干战争结束。埃迪尔内已于3月26日向保加利亚投降。

sources.title: Committee of Union and Progress（Wikipedia 镜像页，述伦敦条约与埃迪尔内陷落）
sources.quote: Following reports that the Ottoman army had at most 165,000 troops to oppose the 400,000 of the League army together with news that morale in the army was poor due to Edirne's surrender to Bulgaria on 26 March, the pro-war regime finally agreed to an armistice on 1 April 1913 and signed the Treaty of London on 30 May, acknowledging the loss of all of Rumelia except for Constantinople.

sources.title: Human Conflicts, Balkan Wars（述伦敦条约与领土结果）
sources.quote: The First Balkan War ended with the Treaty of London (30 May 1913), stripping the Ottoman Empire of nearly all its European territory.

fact: 1913年6月11日，大维齐尔兼陆军大臣谢夫凯特帕夏在君士坦丁堡被暗杀；赛义德·哈利姆帕夏继任大维齐尔并兼任外交大臣，至1915年10月。此后统一与进步委员会全面掌权，自由与协约党等反对派被压制，其领袖流亡欧洲。

sources.title: Second Constitutional Era（Wikiwand）
sources.quote: Mahmud Shevket Pasha would be assassinated on 11 June 1913 ... After his death, he was succeeded by Said Halim Pasha, and CUP began to repress Freedom and Accord and other opposition parties, forcing many of their leaders (such as Prince Sabahaddin) to flee to Europe.

sources.title: Dissolution of the Ottoman Empire（Wikipedia 镜像页）
sources.quote: The new grand vizier Mahmud Sevket Pasha was assassinated by Freedom and Accord supporters just in 5 months after the coup in June 1913. ... Said Halim Pasha who was already Foreign Minister, became Grand Vizier in June 1913 and remained in office until October 1915.

fact: 第二次巴尔干战争于1913年6月29—30日夜间由保加利亚进攻马其顿的塞尔维亚、希腊军队开始；罗马尼亚7月11日参战，奥斯曼帝国于7月12日（另说7月15日或16日）向保加利亚进攻，7月20日（另说7月22日）收复埃迪尔内，保加利亚7月29—30日求和。各来源对奥斯曼参战与收复埃迪尔内的具体日期相差二至三天。

sources.title: Armed Conflict Events Data, Second Balkan War 1913
sources.quote: The war began on June 30, 1913, when King Ferdinand of Bulgaria ordered his troops to attack Serbian and Greek forces in Macedonia. ... Romania declared war on Bulgaria on July 11, 1913 ... The Ottoman Empire declared war on July 15, 1913; Ottoman troops recaptured Adrianople (Edirne) on July 20th. ... Bulgaria was forced to sue for peace July 30, 1913.

sources.title: 百度百科,第二次巴尔干战争
sources.quote: 而奥斯曼帝国也欲乘机收复失地，于7月12日向保加利亚发动进攻。……保加利亚国王斐迪南一世被迫于7月29日求和。

sources.title: 中国社会科学院俄罗斯东欧中亚研究所,第二次巴尔干战争
sources.quote: 6 月29 日，保对塞、希发动突然攻击，遭到猛烈抵抗。土耳其欲乘机收复失地，于7月16日向保加利亚发动进攻。7月29 日保加利亚力屈乞和。

fact: 1913年8月10日，保加利亚与塞尔维亚、希腊、黑山、罗马尼亚签订《布加勒斯特条约》，第二次巴尔干战争结束：塞尔维亚取得马其顿大部，希腊取得马其顿南部、西色雷斯与克里特，罗马尼亚取得南多布罗加。9月29日，保加利亚与奥斯曼帝国签订《伊斯坦布尔条约》（又称《君士坦丁堡和约》），奥斯曼收回东色雷斯与埃迪尔内，西部边界定于马里查河。

sources.title: Armed Conflict Events Data, Second Balkan War 1913
sources.quote: The Treaty of Bucharest, ending the war, was signed on August 10, 1913. ... The Ottoman Empire regained Adrianople (Edirne) and established the western boundary of the empire at the Maritsa River.

sources.title: 百度百科,第二次巴尔干战争
sources.quote: 1913年9月29日，保加利亚与奥斯曼帝国签订《伊斯坦布尔条约》（又称《君士坦丁堡和约》），将东色雷斯和亚得里亚堡（埃迪尔内）交还给奥斯曼帝国。

fact: 1913年1月政变后，君士坦丁堡军事长官杰马尔实施比此前历届政府更严厉的紧急状态，大批逮捕并压制反对派；议会中统一与进步委员会席位占比由1908年的39%升至67%，1914年选举在单党框架下举行、该党囊括全部选区。政变后「行动是否合宪」不再是当局的约束条件。

sources.title: Committee of Union and Progress（Wikipedia 镜像页，述紧急状态与合宪性）
sources.quote: The immediate aftermath of the coup resulted in a much more severe state of emergency than previous governments had ever implemented. Cemal in his new capacity as military commander of Constantinople was responsible for arresting many and heavily stifling opposition. At this point the Unionists were no longer concerned with their actions being considered constitutional.

sources.title: Second Constitutional Era（Wikiwand，述议席占比与1914年选举）
sources.quote: the percentage of representatives from Arab provinces increased from 23% (1908) to 27%, Turkomans 14% (1908) to 22% and in total CUP members from 39% (1908) to 67%. ... New elections were held in 1914 in a single-party framework, and the CUP gained all constituencies.

fact: 奥斯曼公债管理局（Düyun-ı Umumiye）自1881年设立至1913年仍在运作：它直接征收盐、烟草、丝、印花、酒精、渔业等税项，理事会由英、法、德、奥、意、荷债权人各派代表加一名奥斯曼代表组成；雇员约5,000人，鼎盛时达9,000人，多于帝国财政部本身。它同时是外国公司寻求投资机会的中介。

sources.title: Ottoman Public Debt Administration（Wikiwand 条目）
sources.quote: Its governing council included one representative each from British, French, German, Austrian, Italian, Dutch, and Ottoman creditors, and one representative from the Ottoman state. It employed 5,000 officials who collected taxes that were then turned over to the European creditors. At its peak it had 9,000 employees, more than the empire's finance ministry. ... The OPDA was provided monopolies on salt and tobacco by the state. It was afforded taxes on stamps, alcohol, fishing, and silk.

sources.title: Syria and Lebanon under French Mandate（述公债局征收的税种）
sources.quote: Certain revenues had long since been allotted to the service of the Ottoman Public Debt, a monopolistic joint-stock company which supported its own administration for collection; these were the taxes on alcohol, tobacco, silk, salt, and skins, with a stamp-duty and various licence-fees

fact: 1913年君士坦丁堡一名普通劳工的平均日薪为14.1库鲁（kuruş），折合月收入约350库鲁；同年奥斯曼外交部官员月薪均值1,177库鲁、全体文官均值1,166库鲁。分行业名义日薪为：煤矿10.5皮阿斯特、纺织6.1、面粉厂15.1（皮阿斯特与库鲁同值）。1914年伊斯坦布尔商会估算的中等家庭月预算为945库鲁（含房租150库鲁）。

sources.title: Istanbul Households: Marriage, Family and Fertility 1880-1940（Cem Behar & Alan Duben，引1913年工资）
sources.quote: let us take the average daily wage (14.1 kurus ) of an Istanbul labourer in 1913. This was the equivalent of a monthly income of around 350 kurus . The mean monthly salary of Ottoman Foreign Ministry officials in Istanbul at that time was 1,177 kurus , more than three times the wage of thelabourer. The average wage paid to Ottoman civil servants in Istanbul in 1913 was surprisingly close to that – 1, 166 kuruş.

sources.title: 1914-1918-online, Labour, Labour Movements and Strikes (Ottoman Empire/Middle East)
sources.quote: Nominal daily wages in coal mining increased from an average of 10.5 piasters in 1913 to 60 piasters in 1918; in the textile industry, from 6.1 piasters to 40 piasters; and in flourmills, from 15.1 piasters to 65 piasters.

sources.title: Findley, Economic Bases of Revolution and Repression in the Late Ottoman Empire（1986，PDF）
sources.quote: there is a more complete estimate for 1914 that sets the budget for a family of middle standing (orta halli), as reckoned by the Istanbul Chamber of Commerce, at 945 kuruş. Of this, 150 is for rent

fact: 两次巴尔干战争（1912年10月—1913年8月）合计造成约15万至20万军人及平民死亡，各方的独立估计为：保加利亚3.2万—4.5万、塞尔维亚1.5万—2.5万、奥斯曼3万—5万、希腊0.5万—1万、黑山0.3万；霍乱与伤寒造成的死亡与战斗相当。战争同时造成大量穆斯林居民从巴尔干迁往安纳托利亚，形成跨年度的人口流动与安置压力。

sources.title: Human Conflicts, Balkan Wars（附各方死亡估计与疾病说明）
sources.quote: The wars killed an estimated 150,000 soldiers and tens of thousands of civilians. ... INDEPENDENT ESTIMATE Bulgaria: 32,000-45,000 killed; Serbia: 15,000-25,000; Ottoman Empire: 30,000-50,000; Greece: 5,000-10,000; Montenegro: 3,000 ... Disease killed as many soldiers as combat, particularly cholera and typhus.

sources.title: Second Balkan War 1913（Armed Conflict Events Data，另一组国别损失）
sources.quote: One estimate of casualties suggests the number of loses to be Bulgaria (18,000); Greece (12,500); Montenegro (2,000); Romania (1,500); Serbia (18,500); and the Ottoman Empire (20,000).

fact: 巴格达铁路（柏林—巴格达）1913年仍在分段施工：科尼亚至乌卢克什拉已通车，陶鲁斯山段需架设约35座桥梁与高架桥，阿勒颇成为主要施工基地、每日有20—25车材料运抵，全线工地雇用约7.2万人；1913—1914年英德就巴格达至波斯湾段由国际公司承建达成安排。到一战爆发时，铁路距其预定终点仍差约960公里。

sources.title: The Bagdad Railway, New Zealand Graphic, 4 June 1913（Papers Past 影印）
sources.quote: The line has been opened to traffic from Konia to Ulukishlar, at the foot of the Taurus Mountains. ... No less than thirty-five costly bridges and viaducts of varying sizes have been found requisite to consummate this mountain section. ... a train of twenty to twenty-five cars of railway material arriving at Aleppo daily

sources.title: Berlin-Baghdad railway（Wikipedia 镜像页，述1914年前进度）
sources.quote: By the outbreak of World War I, the railway was still 960 km (600 miles) away from its intended objective. ... Technical difficulties in the remote Taurus Mountains and diplomatic delays meant that by 1915 the railway was still 480 kilometres (300 mi) short of completion
